aiml.title: AI & Machine Learning Engineer
aiml.description: Seeking an AI/ML Engineer experienced in developing deep learning and machine learning systems using Python, TensorFlow, Keras, or PyTorch, and Scikit-learn. Must have hands-on experience in image recognition, CNN architectures, NLP, RAG pipelines, or medical/text analytics. Knowledge of REST APIs (FastAPI/Flask), Git version control, model deployment (Vercel, Render, or Streamlit), and data manipulation with Pandas and NumPy is essential.

data_science.title: Data Scientist & Analytics Engineer
data_science.description: Looking for a Data Scientist to build predictive analytics models, automated ETL data pipelines, and analytics dashboards. Must be proficient in Python, SQL, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, and data visualization tools like Seaborn or Plotly. Experience with OCR, text analytics, sentiment analysis, MySQL or PostgreSQL, and cloud services like Azure or AWS is highly desirable.

python.title: Python & Backend Systems Engineer
python.description: Seeking a Python Software Engineer to build scalable backend services, asynchronous APIs, and data processing systems. Required proficiency in Python 3, FastAPI or Django/Flask, relational databases like MySQL or PostgreSQL, REST API architecture, Git workflows, and database integration (SQLAlchemy or raw SQL). Experience with Docker, Redis caching, microservices, and automated testing is strongly preferred.

fullstack.title: Full-Stack AI & Cloud Engineer
fullstack.description: Looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer proficient in React, Next.js, or JavaScript frontend paired with Python (FastAPI/Django) or Node.js backends. Must have hands-on experience building REST APIs, working with SQL or NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Supabase, MongoDB), Git version control, responsive Tailwind CSS design, and deploying on cloud infrastructure (Vercel, Render, AWS, Docker).

frontend.title: Frontend React & Next.js Engineer
frontend.description: Seeking a Frontend Engineer to architect responsive, high-performance web applications using React, Next.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Experience with modern state management, component architecture, REST API integration, Git workflows, mobile-first responsive design, and performance optimization is essential.

backend.title: Backend Cloud & Microservices Engineer
backend.description: Looking for a Backend Engineer experienced in building resilient distributed services using Node.js/NestJS or Python/FastAPI. Strong understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL), database indexing, ORMs (Prisma, SQLAlchemy), REST API architecture, caching with Redis, Docker containerization, and Git workflows.
